region: each explicit segment distributes fractional height from its own entry cursor to the finite column bottom
roundoff: recomposition cannot move the terminal fixed line to another region by floating-point overshoot
isolation: fixed content and fractional weights are local to one segment
style_transport: one outer Styled wrapper is preserved independently on every explicit segment
fixed_prefix: direct unwrapped text before the first fractional block closes the line, applies max(0, par.spacing - par.leading), and reserves that boundary plus pending initial top-edge and exact flush_line advance
preserve: P1374-P1378 and fractional footnotes remain fail-closed
